result.summary: The environment features a wide, well-maintained sidewalk with a curb ramp and tactile paving, indicating some level of accessibility. However, the area is dominated by a commercial car dealership with multiple potential vehicle conflict points and lacks visible crosswalk markings or pedestrian signals.

hazards.name: Driveway Conflict Points
hazards.description: The car dealership has multiple access points across the sidewalk, increasing the risk of vehicle-pedestrian collisions.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and right side where cars are parked behind a low chain

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Large commercial signage and utility poles near the corner may partially block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Large 'Auto Star' sign and utility poles in the center foreground

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way at the intersection.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation
interventions.description: Reduce the number of curb cuts for the commercial property to minimize conflict points between vehicles and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffer
interventions.description: Add street trees or a planting strip to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway/parking lot.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane arterial road with a marked crosswalk but significant pedestrian exposure due to the long crossing distance. While sidewalks and traffic signals are present, the environment lacks physical protection like refuge islands for pedestrians crossing the wide roadway.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway at the intersection.

hazards.name: Wide Travel Lanes
hazards.description: The width of the roadway encourages higher vehicle speeds, increasing the risk and potential severity of collisions.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, car-oriented commercial intersection with marked crosswalks but significant pedestrian exposure due to the long crossing distance. The environment lacks physical protection like refuge islands, and the pavement surface is in fair to poor condition with visible cracking.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide intersection requires pedestrians to cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time.

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven asphalt in the roadway and near the crosswalk area creates trip hazards.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Large vehicles and parked cars near the intersection corners may block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of image (truck) and background left (parked cars)

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Islands
interventions.description: Install raised islands in the center of the roadway to provide a safe waiting area and reduce exposure.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Pavement Repair
interventions.description: Resurface the intersection and crosswalk areas to eliminate trip hazards and improve accessibility.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalk markings and curb ramps, providing basic pedestrian infrastructure. However, the wide roadway creates a significant crossing distance, and the lack of a pedestrian refuge island or curb extensions increases exposure to vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide expanse of the intersection increases the time pedestrians are exposed to moving vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: The marked crosswalk spanning the main roadway.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Large vehicles parked or idling near the intersection can block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: White truck on the left side of the image near the intersection.

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radii
hazards.description: The corner geometry allows for high-speed vehicle turns, which is dangerous for pedestrians at the curb.
hazards.location_in_image: The curb corner on the right side of the image.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a raised island in the center of the roadway to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians mid-crossing.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light.
